national_news.title: Nation Observes Partition Horrors Remembrance Day
bullets: The nation pays homage to those who sacrificed their lives and suffered during the partition in 1947.
Programmes are being organised across the country to commemorate the day.
The Government had decided to observe 14th August every year as Partition Horrors Remembrance Day in 2021.

national_news.title: Iga Swiatek beats Elena Rybakina to claim Women’s Singles title at Canadian Open Tennis
bullets: Iga Swiatek won the Women’s Singles title in Toronto with a 6-2 6-3 win over Elena Rybakina.
Ben Shelton won the Men’s Singles title in Montreal by defeating Brandon Nakashima with a score of 6-3, 7-6(4).
Iga Swiatek captured her first title of the season, giving her a confidence boost heading into the US Open.

national_news.title: Kashmiri diaspora protests against state-sponsored terror in PoJK
bullets: Kashmiri diaspora groups in Belgium, Italy, and the UK held protests against state-sponsored terror in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir (PoJK).
The protests called for international scrutiny of the situation in PoJK and condemned deaths and alleged abuses by Pakistani security forces.
The demonstrations expressed support for the Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC) and highlighted the human rights situation in PoJK.

national_news.title: UNSC links Delhi Red Fort suicide car bombing to Al-Qaida in Indian Subcontinent
bullets: The UNSC's Analytical Support and Sanctions Monitoring Team attributed the Red Fort suicide car bombing to Al-Qaida in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS).
AQIS has evolved into a regional terrorist entity, establishing logistics and financial networks.
The report highlights AQIS's decentralized and scattered operational structure.

national_news.title: Iran rejects US claim of total control over Strait of Hormuz
bullets: Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi rejected US President Donald Trump's claim of total control over the Strait of Hormuz.
Mr. Araghchi accused the US of making miscalculations over the strategic waterway due to intelligence failures.
Iran has rejected Mr. Trump's claims, saying that the strategic waterway remains under its control.

national_news.title: India wins 35 medals, including 13 gold, at Commonwealth Fencing Championship
bullets: India secured 13 gold, 8 silver, and 14 bronze medals at the Commonwealth Fencing Championship.
The senior Indian fencers claimed 5 gold medals in 6 events on the final day of the competition.
India emerged as the overall champions at the Commonwealth Fencing Championship.

national_news.title: Country's exports register robust growth of over 13% in July
bullets: Total exports, including merchandise and services, estimated at 80.14 billion US dollars in July.
Merchandise shipments jumped over 19.6% to 44.24 billion US dollars from a year earlier.
Growth in merchandise exports driven by petroleum products, electronic goods, and engineering goods.

national_news.title: NITI Aayog highlights 12 priority sectors to make India a global manufacturing hub
bullets: NITI Aayog has identified 12 priority sectors for India to become a global manufacturing hub.
The sectors include automobiles, electronics, steel, capital goods, defence and drones, chemicals, solar PV, textiles, pharmaceuticals, and others.
The report aims to strengthen India's manufacturing ecosystem and support the vision of Viksit Bharat.

national_news.title: Global Crude Oil Prices Decline Due to Weaker Demand and Higher US Stocks
bullets: Brent crude price fell by 1.8% to $87.41 per barrel.
West Texas Intermediate crude price declined by 1.9% to $81.65 per barrel.
US commercial crude oil inventories increased by 17.4 million barrels to 424.4 million barrels.

national_news.title: Digital Rupee for DBT under PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana to be launched in Chandigarh
bullets: The Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) – Digital Rupee (e₹) will be used for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) under PMGKAY.
Chandigarh will be the first Union Territory in the country to undertake a full-fledged roll-out of the Digital Rupee.
This initiative marks the next evolution by the Government of India in welfare delivery, from physical distribution to digital delivery through CBDC.

national_news.title: Nation celebrates 80th Independence Day by organising Tiranga rallies
bullets: NCC Maharashtra organised Tiranga rallies across Mumbai to celebrate India's 80th Independence Day.
The rallies showcased patriotism, youth power, and national pride, with cadets from schools and colleges participating.
The event was part of NCC Maharashtra's Independence Day campaign, promoting community engagement and national unity.

national_news.title: India Building Capabilities in Semiconductor and AI Technologies
bullets: India is building capabilities from chip design and fabrication to computing infrastructure and indigenous AI models.
Government initiatives are being taken across both semiconductor and AI technologies to recognize their convergence.
Semiconductors are the foundation of modern technology, powering everything from smartphones and vehicles to satellites and AI systems.

national_news.title: President Murmu presents Sangeet Natak Akademi fellowships, awards to over 100 artists
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu conferred the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships and Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards on eminent artists for 2024 and 2025.
The ceremony was held at Vigyan Bhawan in Delhi.
Over 100 artists received the fellowships and awards.

national_news.title: India's Energy Landscape Transforms to Meet Rising Demand and Strengthen Security
bullets: India is expanding non-fossil energy capacity to meet rising demand.
The country is strengthening domestic energy resources and developing new technologies for the future.
Policy support, infrastructure development, domestic production, manufacturing expansion, and wider energy access are shaping India's energy transformation.

national_news.title: PIB Hyderabad workshop seeks to dispel myths around organ donation
bullets: PIB Hyderabad organised a workshop on organ donation to highlight common myths and medical facts.
Experts stressed the importance of donor families, public awareness, and voluntary pledges.
NOTTO's Jug Jug Jiyo campaign aims to encourage organ donation.

national_news.title: Monsoon Session of Parliament Adjourns Sine Die; 12 Bills Passed by both Houses of Parliament
bullets: The Monsoon Session, 2026 of Parliament was adjourned sine die on Thursday, the 13th of August, 2026.
A total of 12 Bills were passed by both Houses of Parliament during the session.
The session provided 19 sittings spread over a period of 25 days.

national_news.title: Organ donation gives new lease of life: Dr Sree Bhushan Raju
bullets: Organ donation is a noble act that gives a new lease of life to recipients.
Dr Sree Bhushan Raju is a prominent figure in promoting organ donation.
The topic highlights the importance of organ donation in saving lives.

national_news.title: NCSC to Review Union Government's Handling of Posts Reserved for Scheduled Caste Candidates
bullets: NCSC Chairperson Kishor Makwana to review the union government's handling of posts reserved for Scheduled Caste candidates.
The review aims to ensure that the government is adhering to the rules and regulations regarding reservation of posts for Scheduled Castes.
The move is a significant step towards promoting social justice and equality in the country.

national_news.title: Stage set for 80th Independence Day Celebrations at Red Fort
bullets: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi will lead the 80th Independence Day Celebrations from the Red Fort in Delhi on August 15, 2026.
The grand event is set to commemorate 150 years of the enduring national song 'Vande Mataram' and 'Yuva Shakti for Viksit Bharat@2047'.
'Vande Mataram' will be rendered for the first time as part of the celebrations.

national_news.title: Assam is India's Third-Highest Rubber Producing State
bullets: Assam is the third-largest rubber-producing state in India, after Kerala and Tripura.
India is a major producer and consumer of natural rubber.
Rubber is an elastic, flexible, and resilient material produced from the rubber tree.

national_news.title: Ahmedabad Metro Phase Three Secures PIB Clearance
bullets: Ahmedabad Metro Phase Three has secured clearance from the Public Investment Board (PIB).
This development is a significant step towards the construction of the new metro phase.
The project aims to improve the transportation infrastructure in Ahmedabad.

national_news.title: NITI Aayog Report on Key Sectors to Position India as a Global Manufacturing Hub
bullets: NITI Aayog has released a report titled 'Key Sectors to Position India as a Global Manufacturing Hub'.
The report aims to strengthen India's manufacturing aspirations and drive growth through strategic sectors.
The report focuses on advancing the vision of 'Viksit Bharat' through effective interventions for furthering the manufacturing ecosystem.

national_news.title: Building a Business-Ready India: Advancing Ease of Doing Business
bullets: The Government has undertaken reforms to reduce compliance burdens and enhance transparency.
Efforts are being made to advance Ease of Doing Business through digital single-window systems and simplified incorporation processes.
The aim is to create greater opportunities for enterprises of all sizes and encourage entrepreneurship.

national_news.title: India's Indigenous Rare Earth Permanent Magnet Manufacturing Initiative Gains Momentum
bullets: The Ministry of Heavy Industries received 20 bids under the Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent (REPM).
The initiative aims to strengthen the domestic REPM manufacturing ecosystem and enhance competitiveness in global markets.
The scheme received an overwhelming response, with 20 bids received through a global tender on the CPP portal.

national_news.title: President approves 78 Gallantry awards (13 posthumous) & 89 Mention-in-Despatches
bullets: President Smt Droupadi Murmu approved 78 Gallantry awards, including 13 posthumous, to Defence Forces and Central Armed Police Forces personnel.
The awards include 09 Kirti Chakras, 01 Bar to Shaurya Chakra, 19 Shaurya Chakras, 05 Bars to Sena Medals, and 36 Sena Medals.
These awards were given on the eve of 80th Independence Day 2026.

national_news.title: Union Minister Manohar Lal inaugurates Har Ghar Tiranga kiosk as part of nationwide patriotic campaign
bullets: Union Minister Manohar Lal inaugurated the Har Ghar Tiranga kiosk at the India Habitat Centre (IHC), New Delhi.
The inauguration is part of the nationwide Har Ghar Tiranga campaign being observed.
The campaign aims to promote patriotism and national unity among citizens.

national_news.title: MMDR Amendment Bill, 2026 - PIB
bullets: The Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957 governs mining in India.
The Union controls mine regulation for the wider public interest.
The MMDR Amendment Bill, 2026 aims to bring certainty and uniformity in mineral taxation.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Get World Trade Centre in Patna: CM
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister announces plan to build a World Trade Centre in Patna.
The project aims to make Bihar a leading inland fish-producing state by 2030.
The state government will focus on value addition from production to enhance the state's economy.
